name: Tetrahydrocannabutol
summary: Tetrahydrocannabutol is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Δ9-THCB, showed an affinity for the human CB1 (Ki = 15 nM) and CB2 receptors (Ki = 51 nM) comparable to that of Δ9-THC. The formalin test in vivo was performed on Δ9-THCB in order to reveal possible analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The tetrad test in mice showed a partial agonistic activity of Δ9-THCB toward the CB1 receptor. THCB has rarely been isolated from cannabis samples, but appears to be less commonly present than THC or THCV.

uses.text: THCB was studied by Roger Adams as early as 1942.
